title: Modern home, Nashville skyline view.
description:
Enjoy a stay in a clean, stylish town home, near all of Nashville. A modern home with an amazing view of the Nashville skyline, an unbeatable spot for watching the city's fireworks, located on the North side. Plenty of room for up to 8 guests. Beds are clean and fitted with fresh linens, and the home is cleaned and sanitized after every guest's stay. A 2 car garage too. A full home, and outfitted kitchen, at a competitive cost to a 2 person hotel room in Nashville. No chore list, enjoy our stay.

The space
A 3 story town home. The first floor is the garage and entry. The master and second bedroom are located on the second floor. The top floor has the third bedroom kitchen, living space, and an unbeatable view of downtown Nashville. A fantastic spot to watch fireworks on NYE, and the 4th of July.

Guest access
The home is accessed by a unique key code for each guest.

Other things to note
Must be able to climb stairs.
